state.task: Desktop Chinese enterprise talent-development prototype. User explicitly requests narrower, tighter and consistent category trees and similar scope/navigation panels across all pages. Judge actual UI geometry, not HR data.
constraints: Existing primary navigation is 184px, do not alter it
No decorative captions or colored one-sided card borders
Retain tree hierarchy, expand controls, filtering, search, editing and keyboard focus
Main settings tree is a full-width editable two-level data structure, not a navigation rail

indicator.depths: up to 5 with long Chinese labels

category_width.instructions: Choose the best common width balancing user request, readable short categories and table space. 13px Chinese typical4-8characters; deep nodes can ellipsize with title retaining full name.

criteria.w176: 176px compact, more clipping at deep levels
criteria.w184: 184px moderate reduction from208, major reduction from246
criteria.w192: 192px conservative shrink with extra text room
criteria.keep208: Keep208 because narrowing is too risky

row_density.instructions: Choose consistent category/scope/detail row geometry given desktop density request. No overlaid click areas.

criteria.r36: 36px rows,20px text line,8px horizontal padding,no external vertical gaps
criteria.r40: 40px rows,20px text line,8px horizontal padding,no external vertical gaps

scope.instructions: How should analogous UI be unified without changing business behavior?

criteria.by_role: Common density, typography, hover/active/focus,16px indent. Same category/department/sequence rail width; detail nav144px; popup trees use the category width; editable main settings tree only shares row rhythm and typography, retains inline actions
criteria.literal_all: Set every tree, form stepper, main settings tree and horizontal tab to identical narrow width
criteria.category_only: Only standards and assessment categories; keep all similar department/sequence/picker trees distinct

selection.instructions: Choose a consistent sidebar selection treatment given many existing styles and ban on one-sided decorative card borders.

criteria.rounded_fill: Single pale brand-blue rounded whole-row fill plus blue text, neutral hover, no side stripe, shared by flat/hierarchical navigation
criteria.stripe: Transparent background with thin blue left selection marker only

hierarchy.instructions: Which spacing policy balances compactness and hierarchy?

criteria.consistent16: 16px reserved arrow slot,4px gap,16px indentation increment; arrow only on expandable nodes, leaf reserves space in hierarchical lists; flat lists no empty icon slot; eliminate sequence file icons; long names ellipsize with full title
criteria.keep24: Keep24px arrow slots,8px gaps,22px nested indent and file icons
